_doc: Totenhafen's per-zone ambience (UPDATE 09 section 5, DECISIONS T-145; ZoneAmbience, gravelight/world/zone_ambience.gd). A bed per zone crossfades over crossfade_s when the local player's zone changes; one-shots fire at a random interval in every_s while the zone is current (spatial: placed 5-14 m round the listener). Beds and one-shots are AudioDirector keys in audio.json (built by gravelight/tools_src/gen_ambience_map02.py from CC0 surf / river recordings + synthesis); audio.json music.ambient map02_totenhafen = ambient_map02_storm plays under all of them. UPDATE 10 (T-154) adds the living world's far-off one-shots that need no round: the ships' guns at sea, chains clanking in the hall, radio static in the boat and the signal room; the beds sit 8 dB under a footstep (gravelight/tools_src/amb_loudness.py map02: each bed and each bed with the storm under it, BS.1770 loudness, against the footsteps' loudest 400 ms); the round-bound ones (the lighthouse's foghorn until it goes dark at round 10, the cliff bell, the raid's siren and bombs, the gulls scattering) are MapAmbience events (data/gravelight/map02_ambience.json).
